messages:
Aria: noticed an oddity on the latency dashboard: /v1/chat p50=220ms, p95=160ms on the endpoint summary tile. looks inverted.
Ben: summary or endpoint breakdown? quick-tile can hide provenance.
Aria: summary tile. full breakdown shows expected ordering but the summary flips during certain micro-slices.
Cass: usually a sign of merged rollup artifacts. did we get a spike of proxy cache hits or a routing fallback recently?
metrics-bot: event 6136099000: routing.fallback_quota=true applied to traffic group eu-west-1
Ben: yep that change could send lots of tiny fast proxy samples that, if merged without correct weighting, distort percentiles.
Cass: proposal: backend adds sample_count + origins to rollup response and fixes tdigest merge weight normalization. console can request provenance when user toggles.
Aria: UX ask: small inline toggle next to percentiles: 'Show origins' -> console calls ?provenance=origins. default off. also surface sample_count and a low-sample badge when count<75.
Ben: agree. also log rollout_reason in telemetry so we can filter rollups by whether they hit fallback routing.
Cass: implementation plan: 1) API: rollup?provenance=origins|merged + sample_count field 2) merge fix + unit tests 3) console toggle and low-sample indicator. ETA 48h.
Aria: can someone open a PR and schedule staging deploy? will validate inversion window after staging.
Ben: PR #1367 opened. includes provenance param, sample_count, tdigest normalization tests. tagging @eng-platform for review.
deploy-bot: deploy 6136107905 to staging started by @ci-bot
deploy-bot: deploy 6136107925 to staging succeeded :white_check_mark:
Aria: checked staging for the problematic window: p95 now 230ms > p50 220ms. low-sample badge shows on the micro-slice. looks fixed.
Ben: scheduling prod deploy tonight 23:15 UTC. will post when live.
Cass: adding runbook blurb explaining low-sample badge and how support can enable provenance for customers.
